breakdown.description: The wall is labeled adiabatic (zero heat flux) but a fixed temperature boundary condition is simultaneously imposed on the same surface.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified the contradictory boundary conditions (adiabatic and fixed temperature at the same surface x=0). It resolved the conflict by creating a well-posed problem: it kept the fixed temperature at x=0 (T(0)=350 K) and applied the insulated (adiabatic) condition to the other side of the wall. This is one of the valid interpretations suggested by the ground truth.
